2014.question: Read the stanza given below and answer the questions that follow:
2014.prashna: नीचे दिए गए पद्यांश को पढ़ें और उसके बाद आने वाले प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें:
2014.context:
The fire of love has charred my wings and make me a new. 
I am restless. Where is my beloved?
The sight of mango blossoms fires me at the more!
The greener the garden, the brighter burns my heart!
My flaming soul asks "Where I where is my beloved?"
Speak! Speak! Where are they leaves so still?"

sub_questions.1: What charred the wings of the koel?
sub_questions.4: What does the flaming soul of the koel ask?

anuprashna.1: कोयल के पंखों को किसने झुलसा दिया?
anuprashna.4: कोयल की जलती हुई आत्मा क्या पूछती है?
